evals.name: full-messaging-house-b2b
evals.prompt: We're launching a new HR compliance product for mid-market companies. Target is VP of HR at 200-1000 person companies. Key competitors are Rippling and Gusto. Can you build us a positioning statement and full messaging house?
evals.expected_output: A positioning statement filling all 6 blanks with specific content (target, need, product name, category, benefit, competitor, differentiation). A messaging house with a tagline, 2-4 pillars, each with headline, subhead, and 3+ proof points. Language notes and competitive watch-outs. Proof points include a mix of features, data, and customer-style quotes.

assertions.text: Positioning statement fills all 6 blanks specifically (no placeholders)
Target customer is specific, not 'companies' or 'HR professionals'
Tagline is present, 5-10 words
2-4 pillars (not 1, not 5+)
Each pillar has headline, subhead, and at least 3 proof points
Proof points include at least 2 different types: feature, data, quote, comparison
Language notes section with 'use' and 'avoid' lists is present
Competitive watch-outs section is present

evals.name: positioning-statement-only
evals.prompt: Write me a positioning statement for a developer tool that helps backend engineers skip building auth from scratch. Competitors: Auth0, Clerk. Target: backend engineers at 10-100 person startups.
evals.expected_output: A single positioning statement in the template form: 'For [target] who [need], [product] is a [category] that [benefit]. Unlike [competitor], our product [differentiation].' All blanks filled with specific content. The benefit is measurable or concrete, not vague.

assertions.text: Response uses the Sheehan template structure
Benefit is specific (a number, a timeframe, or a concrete outcome), not 'better' or 'easier'
Names Auth0 or Clerk explicitly in the competitor line
Differentiation is something the competitor can't easily claim

evals.name: workshop-agenda
evals.prompt: I need to run a 90-minute messaging workshop with our team. Can you give me the agenda?
evals.expected_output: A 90-minute agenda with time blocks covering: target market review, competitive alternatives review, brainstorm of what matters most, pressure-testing (true/different/matters/simple), drafting the positioning statement, and next steps. Attendee list 4-8 people. Pre-reads named.

assertions.text: Agenda fits within 90 minutes with time blocks that sum correctly
Includes review of target market
Includes review of competitive alternatives
Includes brainstorm or inputs-gathering block
Includes pressure-test or filter block (true, different, matters, simple)
Includes drafting the positioning statement
Attendee list is 4-8 people with named roles
Pre-reads are named
